steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Waaaaahhh—!

The phantoms wail all around her, a chorus of torment. She doesn't seem to hear. Her steps are slow, deliberate, almost lazy. She even pauses from time to time, tilting her head to observe the phantoms restrained by her red threads, as if selecting which one to keep as the ferryman for her own crossing.

She finally stops before one and raises her hand. Several wooden swords shoot through the air and pin the creature in place. It convulses a few times before letting out what can only be described as a blood-curdling shriek.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Arrrggghh—!
The creature's agony is palpable, but Lichen feels nothing for it. Her brow stays smooth. There is only intensity in those eyes, a fire fixed on her target. Then she snaps:

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: By my lineage, by my true name, I bind you. Ghosts and spirits, answer me true. Tell me—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: The one I seek... where does she dwell? The path I must walk... where does it lead?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Answer!!

The command leaves her lips, and something answers. Something cold wraps around the back of your neck, thick and slithering, crawling down your spine like a parasite. Behind Lichen, several masses of dark fog are closing in fast—
[Red Flash or Multiple Slashes]
Several threads spring up from thin air, coiling around their limbs and necks. One sharp tug, and they are torn to pieces in an instant.
She pivots on her heel, not sparing you so much as a glance.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Fret not. I promised you safety. Not one of these phantoms will touch you.
True enough, she has swept your surroundings completely clean. But...
At the heart of her formation, the dark mist grows ever denser. More and more spectral figures emerge from within, lunging toward her.
You can't let this continue! You have to stop her!
You stagger toward the center of her formation, but the threads trip you before you can reach her—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Huh?! Wait— Young friend, no!
[Transition for 1s, screen shakes, white flash]
The world lurches, then spins. Pain—searing, white-hot—erupts from your back and chest, flooding your senses until your limbs go numb. The chaos of sound collapses into a single, infinite shriek.
Through the blur, you see Lichen reaching out toward you—
And then, darkness.
